description: Repairs r-txn-1b/nest-depth-recordset-writes: the rd.Requery witness failed 3246 inside any level, so rd stayed at (0, 24) and the effect of the writes was visible only in the final fresh read. On r-txn-1b-main-accdb, Workspaces(0): dynaset rw on Lv; read the Lv sum through a snapshot. Eight times, level n = 1..8: BeginTrans, DBEngine.Errors, rw.MoveFirst, rw.Move(n - 1), rw.Edit, V = 2^(n - 1), rw.Update, DBEngine.Errors, then the Lv sum through a NEW snapshot (no Requery). Then nine times: Rollback, DBEngine.Errors, the Lv sum through a new snapshot. Finally Lv through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
